verdict: genuinely built; every role completes essential daily work in-product without a spreadsheet

findings.title: Payroll 'Выплачен' is an unreconciled attestation (period paid while remaining>0)
UI shows competing profit/cash definitions as single numbers (profit slot 2 defs + omits payroll; ООО snapshot vs fact side-by-side; card-vs-list divergence)
Refund correction loop UI dead-end (returned refund doc step unreachable)
Expense owner-budget approval branch dead (pending_owner_budget_approval never reached)
Payroll obligation reversal + mandatory per-occurrence settle have no UI (perpetual overdue)
New-company onboarding demo-company trap (first registrant -> hardcoded demo)
Missing/undifferentiated states (no loading; permission=silent redirect; empty=filter-empty; no-access=404=deleted)
Raw error text leaks to user in 2 payroll actions
Terminology overload («Отменить» x5; pay action='Оплачено'; 15+ un-unified label maps; EXPENSE_STATUS_LABELS duplicated)
Dashboard cards lack period/legal-entity labels; breakEven mislabeled; analytics KPIs no drill-through
Form/file polish (no required markers; type=number inconsistency; no upload progress bar; generic refund errors)
Expense/refund approval detail lack a full who-approved-when timeline
Confirmed regional transfer cannot be undone in UI (manual «Приход Иное» no linkage)
DEFERRED: OFD fitness-vocabulary hardcodes; Documents stub; Balances redirect; Saby flag (white-label)
